ratchetRule: V3 preserves one server semantic authority. Browser surfaces consume routing, work queue, procedure guides, review inbox, deterministic insights, decision, epistemic and evidence projections and may not create authority locally.
limitations: V3 Experimental means coherent experimental product use, not production readiness or certification.
Procedure routing is deterministic operational assistance and always requires human selection; it is not an applicability or legal classification decision.
Coverage is bounded to the declared universe and heatmap values require human-reviewed risk ratings.
AI insight narratives cannot modify KPI, work queue, heatmap or decisions and require human validation against the same deterministic basis.
Deployment readiness remains bounded by explicit external controls and attestations.
